rebalance_owner_only_documented.meaning: rebalanceFunds is documented (interface and docstring) as callable only by the owner

current_balance.meaning: vault DLF balance at the checkpoint before the rebalance call

target_balance.meaning: vault target DLF balance at the checkpoint before the rebalance call

offchain_behavior_miscalibrated.meaning: off-chain custodian behavior becomes miscalibrated (e.g. sends funds in response to an attacker-triggered event, or misinterprets vault state)

assumptions: The attacker-triggered rebalanceFunds call is the event that off-chain custodians may react to or misinterpret.
The report describes the miscalibration as potential, so the relation is only claimed for the scenario where such an attacker-triggered event occurs.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify which off-chain reaction (funds sent vs. vault-state misinterpretation) constitutes the miscalibration, nor a numeric or structural definition of 'miscalibrated'.

limitations: The impact is potential; the plan formalizes only the conditional scenario in which an attacker-triggered rebalance event leads to off-chain miscalibration.
No numeric targetBalance or buffer amounts are given; the balance relation is symbolic.
Other impacts (DoS, custodian-path routing, griefing) are not formalized by this plan.
